en: Sepia-toned view over a bridge leading toward a large waterside complex of historic stone buildings with corner towers and domed or conical roofs. Cars and pedestrians move across the bridge; trees and a small park frame the foreground while a calm body of water lies between the bridge and the buildings. The architecture suggests a fortified castle or palace integrated into a town setting. No visible printed text appears on the image.
